zones.ctx_en: Long the world’s most dangerous waters for crews (kidnap-for-ransom). Sharply down since 2021 thanks to regional patrols, but criminal capacity remains intact off Nigeria.

zones.ctx_en: Nigeria’s oil heartland: pipeline sabotage, industrial-scale crude theft, armed river gangs. The historical source of Gulf of Guinea piracy.
